subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the shipped provider-plugin callback field attempt remain a supported compatibility field, or begin a formal deprecation and removal cycle in this PR?
rationale: Adding explicit fields is mechanically safe, but declaring an external SDK field deprecated determines a long-term plugin contract and removal obligation that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Keep attempt supported
options.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, document its existing key-index meaning, and add the clearer fields without promising removal.

options.title: Approve staged deprecation
options.body: Keep the annotation only with maintainer-approved compatibility documentation, a removal release or condition, and SDK tests covering the transition.

recommendation.title: Keep attempt supported
recommendation.body: Remove the deprecation annotation, document its existing key-index meaning, and add the clearer fields without promising removal.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged retry-layer work is the strongest available history signal for the intended callback semantics.
